description: Record an integral payment that an external payment provider has already confirmed. This does not charge or capture money and does not consume coupons again. Requires PAYMENT_WRITE.

operation_id.description: operation_id returned by a successful redeem.

amount.description: Integral paid amount in BRL; it must equal the operation total.

external_id.description: Stable payment identifier from the client's payment provider.

paid_at.description: Timestamp at which the external provider confirmed payment.

name: record_operation_payment
title: Record confirmed operation payment
